system.description:
Desert and open-terrain marksmanship, built around long sightlines.

  • Long Sight: Running Shot's trigger is also met when the target is more than 60ft away, even if you have not moved.
  • Waste-Born Patience: Advantage on Survival checks tracking a wounded target you've shot.

features.name: Long Sight
features.description: Running Shot's trigger is also met when the target is more than 60ft away, even if you have not moved.

rules.when: bow attack, vs a target more than 60ft away, even without moving (Running Shot)

features.name: Waste-Born Patience
features.description: Advantage on Survival checks tracking a wounded target you've shot.

rules.when: Survival tracking a wounded target you've shot
